description: Find the ranked sellers that list something for a specific job, by words such as pdf, tweets or web search. Returns two groups, each ordered by what real buyers spent on the seller in the last 30 days: focused, the sellers with every word in at least 1 in 5 of their listed endpoints, each with that share; and mentions, the sellers that list every word somewhere. The spend is the seller's whole spend, not only for what matched, and the words are the sellers' own. Use it when no category fits the job; use best_tools to rank a whole category and seller to check one domain. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

category.description: Keep only sellers in this category, a slug from categories

limit.description: Rows in each group, 10 unless given

max_price.description: Keep only sellers whose median price per call is at most this many USD. Sellers with none stay in

query.description: One to five words of three or more letters or digits, such as pdf or web search

name: search
